Seed Multiplication
Farm
(Establishment and
Committed
Expenditure)
column7:
Augmentation in provision of ` 8.06
lakh was the net effect of increase of
` 18.06 lakh and decrease by re-
appropriation of `10.00 lakh.
Increase of `8.06 lakh was attributed
to need of additional amounts in
gratituous grant item and rent and
tax, medical expenditure by Regional
offices. Increase of `10.00 lakh was
attributed to need of additional
amounts in travelling
allowances/medical allowances items
by Regional offices. Reduction in
provision by re-appropriation of
`10.00 lakh was attributed to
anticipated saving. Reasons for final
saving have not been intimated
(August 2023).
